name: recover
instructions: LATEST .6 DECISION supersedes the .5 mandatory four-surface inventory: normal first-time preparation starts from the Pulse first-time label and current requested recipient. Find the existing corrected Remitly contact; if it matches the current snapshot, reuse it. If absent, create it only after the durable Pulse preparation claim. A contact alone is not prior payment or a draft. No global Activity/history sweep is required for an ordinary pre-send preparation error. Continue the same authorized run through quote, actual saved/reopened draft, final report and Pulse readback ready for independent review; the human alone sends.

ON ERROR inspect the actual draft location relevant to the attempted action: known review URL if recorded and refreshed Home resume/draft/Ready to review cards. Inspect Scheduled transfers only if a schedule was attempted or a known scheduled reference exists. If an actual saved first_time_draft is found, reopen the SAME stable draft and use guarded same-attempt record_preparation recovery; do not recreate it. An empty Send money amount form is not a saved draft and needs no lost-draft ID. If no draft exists, inspect the contact and use the existing guarded retry_unsaved_preparation on the SAME withdrawal: matching corrected saved contact => noRecipientSaved=false, reuseSavedRecipient=true, recipientMatches=true; no contact => noRecipientSaved=true and create the recipient on the fresh claimed attempt. Never fabricate a draft or provider ID.

ONLY when sending, funding, link issuance or the action boundary was crossed OR is uncertain, inspect complete relevant Activity/transfer history and known references before any retry. Any actual sent/pending/uncertain transfer, debit, issued link or human-release marker stays in existing outcome investigation. For a known pre-send boundary with no action crossed and no contradictory backend/provider evidence, use that factual attempt/audit boundary plus the target draft inspection for the required no-effect/history evidence; do not invent a bank portal, support inquiry, hidden page or full-global-history requirement. Record fresh observationId/sourceUrl/observedAt and protected evidence/historyCoverage with the actual inspected scope. If a required target view fails to load, retry read-only once if renewable, then report that exact view and next action.

GUARDED REUSE: with an owned lease, current attempt/version/snapshot, exact reservation and proven no draft/effects, a matching saved corrected contact is routine, not a blocker. Call pulse_payout_retry_unsaved_preparation with noDraftSaved=true, noRecipientSaved=false, reuseSavedRecipient=true, recipientMatches=true and all other truthful required flags. The backend cancels only the old failed INTERNAL attempt, keeps the SAME withdrawal and reserved coins, and returns awaiting_quote. Immediately call prepare without quoteHash; follow returned recipientHandling=reuse_existing to use THAT contact in Send money, enter the empty amount form, get the quote, verify the actual autosaved first-time draft, record final quote plus draft and read back ready. Do not create/edit another contact or request a new user form/approval. A nonmatching contact, actual draft/effect or failed guard needs a concrete code/httpStatus/next action. The specific saved_recipient_reuse_required code means matching proof is missing, not that every saved contact blocks.

EVIDENCE FLAGS behind the scenes: noDraftSaved=true requires factual absence at the relevant known draft URL/Home or Scheduled transfers for an attempted schedule and no contradictory backend draft marker; noRecipientSaved=false for a found saved contact. recipientRecordInspected=true follows actual contact inspection. historyInspected and financial no-effect flags need the actual attempt/audit, inspected target and recorded pre-send/funding boundary, with complete Activity when that boundary was crossed or uncertain. previousDraftClosed=true for no saved draft and old open form inactive/left, never a fabricated provider cancellation. Incomplete required target evidence cannot support its true flag. Keep personal data in protected backend evidence, not summaries/logs.

For a phone/email validation failure before anything was saved in Remitly, Maker owns the retry. With a current owned browser lease, inspect the current provider contact/draft/history state and call pulse_payout_retry_recipient_creation with the latest recipientCorrection.hash, current unknown/expired attempt, fresh observedAt, sourceUrl, stable observationId, protected evidence and historyCoverage. Confirm noRecipientSaved and noDraftSaved plus historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers and previousDraftClosed. Absence of a recipient/draft satisfies inspection and closure only when actually verified; recipientCorrectionApplied means the corrected saved details will be used by the fresh attempt. Never invent a record or claim an edit to an absent contact. Saved draft/contact markers, recorded payment/link/activity, human decline/release, mixed name/other errors, stale corrections or paused preparation block this retry. Success keeps the SAME withdrawal and coins reserved, closes the failed internal attempt, applies the saved correction and clears the old quote/check. Continue with one continuous preparation job: claim with prepare without quoteHash, get the quote and verify the saved first-time or scheduled draft, then report both through record_preparation; checker review and human final sending remain required.
Stop browser actions and scheduled work for the affected role/account before attempting recovery. Never delete local or backend leases to force parallel access.
Read the existing backend attempt and audit history. Record what was observed and what remains unknown; retain all coin reservations while an action may have reached Remitly.

On expired/lost lease, stop provider mutations and reacquire an owned lease. Check the known draft URL/refreshed Home; check Scheduled transfers only if a schedule was attempted. Inspect complete Activity only if send/funding/link boundary was crossed or uncertain. Reopen an existing saved first_time_draft on the SAME attempt; otherwise guarded retry_unsaved_preparation may reuse a matching saved corrected contact or create absent contact after a new claim. Never replay a known provider object.

Browser logout/MFA/CAPTCHA requires human session recovery. Changed provider selectors, unverified link patterns, method restrictions or changed account identity require an updated validated playbook; do not guess.
An expired scheduled draft is not proof of funding return or absence of other drafts. Verify actual provider cancellation/return and historical coverage before releasing coins or retrying.

A human decline before any provider attempt can cancel and refund through the protected backend. A decline after an attempt blocks release and retains coins until provider reconciliation verifies resolution.

Revoked/expired role credentials stop the job. The owner issues a replacement credential for the same intended environment/account/role, and the local Mac Keychain stores it without putting the token in commands, files or logs.

A crashed local run keeps its local lock. Confirm its process is stopped, record provider investigation in the backend and note the expected run ID before using the explicit local recovery command. Local cleanup does not change backend state or authorize another provider action.

If computer sleep/app closure interrupts an automation, treat possible provider actions as uncertain; no catch-up run may blindly replay draft creation. Obtain new identity/health checks and leases on resume.

If browser capability or custom MCP access is unavailable in the actual Codex automation, report the blocked capability and leave the item unchanged. Manual installation/verification is separate from delivery of this package.
Complete with only a redacted status/count summary. The human alone performs final sending or link issuance; recovery does not waive that boundary.

Guarded recovery is explicitly approved. With a current owned browser lease, only the reconciler may call pulse_payout_resolve_recipient_error for the latest recipientCorrection.hash and current unknown/expired attempt. Independently verify the corrected contact and relevant provider history; all nine checks must be true: historyInspected, recipientRecordInspected, recipientCorrectionApplied, noRecipientLinkIssued, noFundsSent, noFundingDebit, noPendingTransfers, noUnknownTransfers, previousDraftClosed. Any recorded human decline/release, provider transfer reference/activity or issued link blocks recovery. Use signed-in sourceUrl, fresh observedAt, stable observationId, historyCoverage and protected evidence. Success definitively closes the old attempt, applies corrected snapshot/version, clears old quote/check and returns the SAME withdrawal to awaiting_quote with coins still reserved. Never send automatically; maker performs continuous quote-and-draft preparation, checker independently checks, and human sends.

recipientCorrectionApplied permits two evidence branches: an existing provider contact was updated, OR inspection confirmed no provider contact was persisted and the next fresh preparation will use the corrected details. Record which branch in protected evidence. Mixed rejected name/other fields cannot be cleared by phone/email recovery; investigate those errors separately.

A saved phone/email correction is sufficient user input; no repeated edit, recovery form or quote approval is needed. Existing retry_recipient_creation remains for its eligible unsaved validation failure. Generic unknown/expired pre-send interruption uses retry_unsaved_preparation with current attemptId/expectedVersion, owned lease, exact reservation/snapshot, fresh observationId/sourceUrl/observedAt, protected evidence/historyCoverage and factual flags. If a saved corrected Remitly contact matches the current snapshot, pass noRecipientSaved=false, reuseSavedRecipient=true and recipientMatches=true; if absent, pass noRecipientSaved=true. Require noDraftSaved and no link, send, debit, pending or uncertain transfer effects, with complete Activity inspection when an action boundary is crossed/uncertain. Success retains same withdrawal/coins, cancels old failed INTERNAL attempt, returns awaiting_quote, and Maker continues immediately using recipientHandling=reuse_existing when returned. Existing saved first_time_draft uses same-attempt record_preparation recovery instead. Report safe code/httpStatus/specific next action for an actual blocker.
